stemBlocks: Electrical power is supplied through a dc transmission line that consists of two metal wires. Each wire is $8.0 \text{ km}$ long and has a cross-sectional area of $1.0 \text{ cm}^2$. The resistivity of the metal from which the wires are made is $2.5 \times 10^{-7} \Omega \text{m}$. Electrical power is transmitted to the transmission line at a potential difference of $24000 \text{ V}$. At what rate is energy being wasted as heat in the wires when the power supplied to the transmission line is $120 \text{ kW}$?

assets.alt: A diagram showing two parallel wires with arrows indicating current flow in opposite directions.
